title: From Accuracy to Impact: The Impact-Driven AI Framework (IDAIF) for Aligning Engineering Architecture with Theory of Change

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluated in a clinical decision support system case study by defining group-conditional risks for racial strata using a Minimax Pareto Fairness (MMPF) formulation, applying adversarial debiasing, and measuring the Equalized Odds Difference.

Evaluated in a clinical decision support system case study by defining group-conditional risks for gender strata using the MMPF formulation, and measuring the Equalized Odds Difference as well as gender-stratified calibration error.

Evaluated architecturally through the Data Layer by measuring demographic balance (ensuring training data probability matches target population probability within a threshold margin) and using Fairness-Aware Demonstration Selection (FADS) to maximize diversity in few-shot examples.
